4780:
4780 cikka ² 'gummy matter in eyes, bird-lime' BHS ii 229. [Cf. cikkáṇa-, cikhalla - (and further forms there
shown), * kicca -: ← Drav. (DED 2053), ← Mu.
(Kuiper) EWA i 385, 386.] Gy. eur. čik (wel. m., gr. f., pl. čiká ) 'mud, dirt, clay,
ashes' (whence čiklo 'dirty'); S. cika f. 'mud', cikaṛu 'greasy'; L. cik f., cikkuṛ m. 'mud', P. cikkaṛ m.; H. cīk , cīkaṛ f. 'mud, slime, recently irrigated land', cīkaṭ f.
'greasy deposit of a lamp'; G. cīk m. 'glutinous and
acrid juice of trees and plants &c., greasiness, beestings', cīkaṭ 'greasy'; M. cīk m. 'viscid ooze or sap or
gum of plants, any viscid matter', cikṭā m. 'clammy
ooze'. — Prob. Ash. šikā́ 'fat' < * čka - ? — Wg. saká 'fat', Kt. skå , Pr. iskī́ , Dm. ⁱskâ , Gaw. sikā́ : all < * ċka - ? Addenda: cikka-²: WPah.kṭg. ċikṭɔ 'greasy', m. 'grease', J. cik f.
'mud, earth', kṭg. ċikṛɔ m. 'mud'.

10304 mḗghya 'being in or coming from a cloud' VS. 2. * mēghiya-. [ mēghá -] 1. Tor. mēg 'hail', Sh.pales. mē̃k ; L.poṭh. mẽghlū m.
